description: List the contacts in a list. Returns {data:[...],paging:{...}} — each contact's id, email_address, fields, tags, status, and created_at. Paginate with `limit` (max 100) and `starting_after`. EmailOctopus: GET /lists/{list_id}/contacts.

starting_after.description: Pagination cursor — the id to start after (from the previous page's paging).

name: emailoctopus_list_contacts
title: List contacts
